agent_explanation: Two-body close encounter: light mass falls toward heavy mass, separation shrinks 1.23 (step80) to 1.02 (step83) while speeds rise. Substep count stays only 3-4 despite strongly growing acceleration, so leapfrog truncation error accumulates as a secular momentum drift (0.0535 vs 0.0503 allowed) triggering momentum_conserved at step 83. Halving dt eliminates the violation, confirming resolution-dependent integrator error, not a physical momentum source.
